$description: What each UI Kit token is for, keyed by its theme path (theme.<path>): DTCG $description and, under $extensions, where to use and avoid it. Never values: they come from the theme. The build checks it and writes it into dist/dtcg.

primary.$description: The action color: primary buttons, links, selection and focus of fields.

use: field border on hover and focus
selected card outline and floating-tab border
avoid: small link text on bgContainer in dark mode: use it for fills or large text there
status meaning: use positive, warning, negative or info

primaryDeep.$description: Pressed fill of primary contained buttons.

primaryStrong.$description: Hover fill of primary contained buttons; emphasized primary text.

primarySubtle.$description: Pressed fill of ghost and subtle buttons; primary hover outline.

use: ghost and subtle button pressed fill

primaryDimmed.$description: Soft primary fill: ghost-button hover, selected subtle buttons, primary badges and avatars.

positive.$description: Success state. Passed, completed or healthy.

use: success icon in banners, snackbars and status icons
avoid: positive buttons (variant positive, positiveSubtle, positiveGhost): Pentaho UI Kit writes white or positive text on them, below AA in light mode, so use a neutral variant (primary for the main action)
color alone: pair it with a label or icon

positiveDeep.$description: Positive banner and snackbar titles; hover fill of positive contained buttons.

use: callout titles on the soft fill
positive contained button hover (status buttons darken to …Deep on hover, unlike primary)

positiveStrong.$description: Positive tag text; pressed fill of positive contained buttons.

positiveDimmed.$description: Soft positive fill behind positive text: tags, badges, status icons, subtle buttons.

use: positive tag, badge and status-icon fill
positive subtle-button fill and ghost-button hover
banner and snackbar fill (mixed half with dimmer)

positiveSubtle.$description: Hover fill of clickable positive tags and positive subtle buttons; pressed fill of positive ghost buttons.

positiveBorder.$description: Outline of positive tags, status icons and subtle buttons.

use: positive subtle button border and pressed fill

warning.$description: Warning state. Needs attention, nothing has failed yet.

use: warning icon in banners, snackbars and status icons
avoid: warning buttons (variant warning, warningSubtle, warningGhost): Pentaho UI Kit writes white or warning text on them, below AA in light mode, so use a neutral variant and say the warning beside it
white text (textLight) on your own warning fills: put textDark on them
color alone: pair it with a label or icon

warningDeep.$description: Warning banner and snackbar titles; hover fill of warning contained buttons.

use: callout titles on the soft fill
warning contained button hover (status buttons darken to …Deep on hover, unlike primary)

warningStrong.$description: Warning tag text; pressed fill of warning contained buttons.

avoid: small text on warningDimmed: below AA in Pentaho UI Kit 7.0 (a known issue of HvTag)

warningDimmed.$description: Soft warning fill behind warning text: tags, badges, status icons, subtle buttons.

use: warning tag, badge and status-icon fill
warning subtle-button fill and ghost-button hover
banner and snackbar fill (mixed half with dimmer)

warningSubtle.$description: Hover fill of clickable warning tags and warning subtle buttons; pressed fill of warning ghost buttons.

warningBorder.$description: Outline of warning tags, status icons and subtle buttons.

use: warning subtle button border and pressed fill

negative.$description: Error state. Failed, invalid or destructive.

use: form error text and invalid field border
error icon in banners, snackbars and status icons
avoid: small error text on bgContainer in dark mode without an icon beside it
color alone: pair it with a label or icon

negativeDeep.$description: Negative banner and snackbar titles; hover fill of negative contained buttons.

use: callout titles on the soft fill
negative contained button hover (status buttons darken to …Deep on hover, unlike primary)

negativeStrong.$description: Negative tag text; pressed fill of negative contained buttons.

negativeDimmed.$description: Soft negative fill behind negative text: tags, badges, status icons, subtle buttons.

use: negative tag, badge and status-icon fill
negative subtle-button fill and ghost-button hover
banner and snackbar fill (mixed half with dimmer)

negativeSubtle.$description: Hover fill of clickable negative tags and negative subtle buttons; pressed fill of negative ghost buttons.

negativeBorder.$description: Outline of negative tags, status icons and subtle buttons.

use: negative subtle button border and pressed fill

info.$description: Informational state. Neutral news, no action needed.

avoid: text on light surfaces: it is an icon and fill color, so write the words in text or infoDeep
color alone: pair it with a label or icon

use: callout titles on the info fill

infoDimmed.$description: Soft info fill behind info text: tags, badges, status icons, subtle buttons.

use: info tag, badge and status-icon fill
banner and snackbar fill (mixed half with dimmer)

infoSubtle.$description: Hover fill of clickable info tags.

infoBorder.$description: Outline of info tags, status icons and subtle buttons.

accent.$description: Accent for highlights that are neither action nor status.

use: a highlight that must not read as the primary action
avoid: primary actions: those are primary
status meaning

use: callout titles on the accent fill

accentStrong.$description: Stronger accent for hover and emphasized accent text; no Pentaho UI Kit component uses it yet.

use: custom accent text or hover in hand-built parts

accentSubtle.$description: Soft accent fill one step above accentDimmed; no Pentaho UI Kit component uses it yet.

use: hover of a custom accent-tinted item

accentDimmed.$description: Softest accent fill: accent banners (mixed half with dimmer) and accent status icons.

accentBorder.$description: Outline of accent status icons and accent-tinted surfaces.

text.$description: Primary text: body copy, titles and values.

textSubtle.$description: Secondary text: help text, placeholders, metadata and subheaders.

avoid: small text on bgPage in light mode: put it on bgContainer
the main value or label of a row: use text

textDisabled.$description: Disabled text, icons and control outlines; intentionally low contrast.

avoid: anything a person must read: disabled text is exempt from contrast, help text is not

textDimmed.$description: A muted gray for control outlines rather than reading text.

use: default border of inputs, selects, dropdowns and tags inputs
avoid: body or help text: use textSubtle

textLight.$description: Light text in both modes, for saturated or dark fills.

use: text and icons on primary, positive and negative fills
avoid: warning fills: use textDark
soft …Dimmed fills: use the family's …Strong text; message text on them: textDark

textDark.$description: Dark text in both modes: on warning fills, and in light mode on the soft …Dimmed fills and the lighter categorical colors.

use: categorical tags on the lighter cat colors (cat1–cat3, cat6–cat9)
avoid: …Dimmed fills in dark mode: they turn dark and the pair measures below AA
small text on cat4, cat5, cat10, cat11 or cat12: below AA in both modes

border.$description: Default border for outlined controls and containers.

use: neutral tag and subtle button outline
panel, section, footer and card outlines
avoid: dividers between rows: use borderSubtle

borderSubtle.$description: Hairline dividers between surfaces and rows.

borderStrong.$description: Emphasized outline of small selection controls.

avoid: container borders: use border

borderDisabled.$description: Outline of disabled checkboxes and radios.

avoid: a card or panel surface: use bgContainer

bgContainer.$description: Surface for containers: cards, panels, dialogs, drawers, tooltips and table rows.

avoid: the page itself: use bgPage

bgPageSecondary.$description: A step darker than the page: selected and focused list items, tracks and placeholders.

use: focused list item, checkbox and radio

bgContainerSecondary.$description: A secondary surface inside containers: nested regions and avatar fills.

use: nested regions inside a card or panel
avoid: a second page background: use bgPage

bgHover.$description: Translucent primary tint for hover on rows, list items, tabs and ghost controls.

use: table row and list item hover
tab, tree item and menu item hover
checkbox, radio and switch hover halo
avoid: a selected state: selection uses bgPageSecondary or primaryDimmed

bgDisabled.$description: Fill of disabled controls and disabled contained buttons.

use: disabled buttons, inputs, tags and list items

bgOverlay.$description: Translucent backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

avoid: a surface for content

dimmer.$description: Mix target that softens colors (light in light mode, dark in dark mode).

avoid: a fill of its own

shad1.$description: The translucent shadow color the elevation is built from; no component uses it directly.

avoid: a fill or border

shadow.$description: Default elevation for raised surfaces; the same in both modes.

avoid: flat page regions: use a border instead

use: chart series in order (a chart takes them in this order)
avoid: status or brand meaning
text on the page: as a fill it carries textDark

use: icon to text inside small controls
gaps in toolbars and button groups

gaps between form fields and cards
